findings.evidence: The declarations occur at lines 40, 89, 104, 117, and 128. Mathlib’s `LinearMap.det_pi` uses `CommRing` plus `Module.Free`/`Module.Finite` (`Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Determinant.lean:390`), while `LinearMap.trace_baseChange` has the same ring-level assumptions (`Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Trace.lean:378`); the submitted proofs use precisely this finite-free basis infrastructure, not field-specific operations.
findings.fix: State the linear-map theorem over `[CommRing K]` with componentwise `Module.Free`/`Module.Finite`; state the Pi norm/trace results with commutative K-algebras and those same module assumptions; and weaken the base-change lemmas’ `K` to `CommRing K`.
findings.issue: The global `[Field K]` and `[Field (L i)]` assumptions over-specialize all five generic declarations: `det_pi_of_apply_eq_dependent`, `Algebra.norm_pi`, `Algebra.trace_pi`, `Algebra.norm_baseChange_tmul`, and `Algebra.trace_baseChange_tmul`.

summary: The reusable package is unnecessarily restricted to fields even though its determinant, norm, trace, and base-change arguments work over finite free modules over commutative rings.
